notablePrerequisites: Empowered Autogenerator has at least four charge counters on it.
description:
Activate Empowered Autogenerator's first ability by tapping it, putting a charge counter on it and adding at least {5}.
Cast Ancestral Statue by paying {4}.
Myrsmith triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Myr artifact creature token.
Ancestral Statue enters the battlefield, triggering itself.
Holding priority, activate Clock of Omens by tapping the Myr and Ancestral Statue, untapping Empowered Autogenerator.
Resolve the Ancestral Statue trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
